note: Step 6 invokes a host-bound factory with the resolved arguments; step 7 requires an entity or a composite instance back, so describe, a host function returning plain data, is a run at the declarator. In app.ts the call in nested value position is not a declarator: F-Call applies at the declarator only, and J1 has no rule for a bare call to a host function, so the file runs there too.
